description: This file implements operations on an object ID set, including creation, insertion, removal, comparison, and parsing from a file. It is a core data structure used within a Git-related project for managing sets of object IDs.

methods.name: void oidset_init(struct oidset * set,size_t initial_size)
methods.description: Initializes an oidset structure, optionally resizing its internal set.

methods.name: int oidset_contains(const struct oidset * set,const struct object_id * oid)
methods.description: Checks if a given object ID is present in the set.

methods.name: bool oidset_equal(const struct oidset * a,const struct oidset * b)
methods.description: Compares two oidsets for equality based on their contents.

methods.name: int oidset_insert(struct oidset * set,const struct object_id * oid)
methods.description: Inserts an object ID into the set.

methods.name: void oidset_insert_from_set(struct oidset * dest,struct oidset * src)
methods.description: Copies all object IDs from one set into another.

methods.name: int oidset_remove(struct oidset * set,const struct object_id * oid)
methods.description: Removes an object ID from the set.

methods.name: void oidset_clear(struct oidset * set)
methods.description: Clears all entries from the set and reinitializes it.

methods.name: void oidset_parse_file(struct oidset * set,const char * path,const struct git_hash_algo * algop)
methods.description: Parses object IDs from a file into the set.

methods.name: void oidset_parse_file_carefully(struct oidset * set,const char * path,const struct git_hash_algo * algop,oidset_parse_tweak_fn fn,void * cbdata)
methods.description: Parses object IDs from a file with detailed handling, including comments and whitespace.
